# <span id="aanchor129"></span> Ad Hoc Data Review

Use the Ad-Hoc Data Review to view a desired set of data based on user-defined parameters. Data can be viewed at the meter or location level, at measured or standard conditions, and at hourly, daily or monthly resolution.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Ad Hoc Data Review:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Rollup Viewers** \> **Ad Hoc Data Review**.
2.  Click the drop-down button under the **Meter** label and select **Meter**, **Location**, or **List**.
3.  Based on your selection in step 2, select a meter, location or list to view data for.
4.  Set the date range for the data you want to view.
    <div class="example">

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

    <div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example">

    To set the date range to August 2018, select August 2018 for the **From Date** and September 2018 for the **To Date**).

    </div>

    </div>
5.  On the **Main** tab, specify whether the data will be at the meter or location level.
6.  Select the resolution for the data display (Hourly, Daily or Monthly).
7.  Specify whether the view will display volume and heating values at measured or standard conditions.
8.  On the **Flow**, **Mol%**, and **HCL** tabs, select the values to be displayed.
9.  Click **Refresh**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 598;height: 484;" />

</div>

## Button Details

The following functions are available on the Ad Hoc Data Review screen:

- **Refresh** – Query the database for the data selected in the left pane.

- **Remove** – Hide selected rows in the grid.

  Select rows on the grid either as a continuous block or by holding the **Ctrl** key and clicking rows, then click Remove to hide those rows. To show hidden rows, click **Refresh**.

- **Find** – Users can enter a value to be searched for in the data grid. Clicking Find Next or Find Previous will take the user from one row to the next with data points that meet the specified criteria. Clicking the Highlight button will cause all cells with the specified criteria to be highlighted with a \<HI\> before and a \</HI\> after every data point that meets the criteria.
